title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget
text: Renders Mosaic deck.gl specification rMosaic rDeckgl saves resulting htmlwidget disk. intended durable exports dbVisuals specs; live dbVisuals canvas continues use SQLRooms React runtime.

title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget
code: dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget(   spec,   file,   engine = "auto",   data = NULL,   data_sql = NULL,   data_name = "agent_data",   con = NULL,   db_path = NULL,   project = NULL,   selfcontained = FALSE,   data_transport = "file",   width = NULL,   height = NULL )  export_htmlwidget(...)

title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget
text: spec widget specification R list, JSON string, JSON file path, existing htmlwidget. Mosaic specs rendered rMosaic; deck.gl specs rendered rDeckgl. file Output HTML file path. engine Export target. "auto" infers spec shape; "rMosaic" "rDeckgl" select R package explicitly. "mosaic" "deckgl" accepted aliases. data Optional named list data.frames register widget. data_sql Optional SQL query fetch con, db_path, project, active SQLRooms database register data_name. data_name Name used registering data_sql results. con Optional DBI connection used data_sql direct DuckDB data nodes rDeckgl spec. db_path Optional DuckDB database path used open temporary read-connection export. project Optional dbProject object DBI connection. selfcontained Passed htmlwidgets::saveWidget(). Defaults FALSE large exports can keep dependencies Arrow payloads files. data_transport Data transport passed rMosaic::mosaic() rDeckgl::deckgl(). Defaults "file" avoid base64 Arrow payloads JSON. width, height Optional widget dimensions. ... Arguments passed dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget().

title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget
text: Invisibly returns list describing exported file, engine, dependency directory, generated data files.

title: Export a dbVisuals spec as an htmlwidget — dbvisuals_export_htmlwidget

title: Launch the dbVisuals browser — launchBrowser
text: Opens browser-based dbVisuals workspace interactive data exploration support deck.gl, Mosaic, R visualizations. interface connects current R session executing R code.

title: Launch the dbVisuals browser — launchBrowser
code: launchBrowser(   db_path = NULL,   project = NULL,   port = 3001,   frontend_port = 5173,   browser = TRUE,   daemon = FALSE,   host = "127.0.0.1",   agent = FALSE,   agent_token = NULL,   agent_allow_write = FALSE,   agent_allow_r = FALSE,   agent_max_rows = 1000L )

title: Launch the dbVisuals browser — launchBrowser
text: db_path Optional path DuckDB database file. NULL, uses -memory database. project Optional `dbProject` R6 object (`dbProject` package) `DBIConnection`. supplied, `db_path` derived connection's underlying DuckDB file. Mutually exclusive `db_path`. port Port number R server (default: 3001) frontend_port Port number frontend server (default: 5173) browser Logical. Open browser automatically (default: TRUE) daemon Logical. Run server background (default: FALSE) host Host address (default: "127.0.0.1") agent Logical. Enable local dbVisuals agent API AI-assisted schema inspection, bounded SQL, materialization, visualization rendering (default: FALSE). agent_token Optional bearer token local agent API. agent = TRUE token supplied, random token generated. agent_allow_write Logical. Allow agent create tables/views persist visualization metadata (default: FALSE). agent_allow_r Logical. Allow agent execute R code existing SQL Rooms R execution path (default: FALSE). agent_max_rows Integer. Maximum rows returned bounded agent SQL queries visualization data previews (default: 1000).

title: Launch the dbVisuals browser — launchBrowser
text: Invisibly returns list server information.

title: Launch the dbVisuals browser — launchBrowser
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ # Launch with in-memory database launchBrowser()  # Launch with a specific GiottoDB database launchBrowser(db_path = "giottodb-visium.db")  # Launch from a dbProject proj <- dbProject::dbProject(path = "my_project", dbdir = "my.duckdb") launchBrowser(project = proj)  # Launch from a raw DBIConnection con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), dbdir = "my.duckdb") launchBrowser(project = con)  # Launch without opening browser launchBrowser(browser = FALSE) } # }

what: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
title: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
text: Materializes -memory `data.frame` DuckDB database backing current SQL Rooms session. `project` supplied (one attached `launchBrowser()` time) table written project's writable connection. Otherwise data.frame stashed package-level cache later retrieval (back-compat behavior).

title: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
code: sqlrooms_export_table(name, data, project = NULL, overwrite = TRUE)

title: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
text: name Character. Table name write. data `data.frame`. project Optional. `dbProject` R6 object `DBIConnection`. Defaults whatever passed [launchBrowser()]. overwrite Logical. Overwrite existing table (default `TRUE`).

title: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
text: lazy `tbl` objects (dbplyr / dbMatrix / dbSpatial), use [sqlrooms_register()] instead, creates SQL VIEW data movement.

title: Export Table to SQL Rooms — sqlrooms_export_table
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ df <- data.frame(x = 1:10, y = rnorm(10)) sqlrooms_export_table("my_table", df) } # }

what: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
text: Creates SQL `VIEW` (optionally `TEMPORARY`) `x` connection associated current SQL Rooms session. data materialized: view lazy alias SPA / `/api/arrow-query` can query.

title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
code: sqlrooms_register(name, x, project = NULL, temporary = FALSE, overwrite = TRUE)

title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
text: name Character. View name create. x lazy `tbl`, dbMatrix/dbSpatial, data.frame. project Optional. `dbProject` R6 object `DBIConnection`. Defaults whatever passed [launchBrowser()]. temporary Logical. Create `TEMPORARY VIEW` (default `FALSE`). Persisted (non-temporary) views written database file visible SPA next page reload. overwrite Logical. Use `CREATE REPLACE VIEW` (default `TRUE`).

title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
text: Invisibly, `dplyr::tbl()` pointing new view, `TRUE`.

title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
text: Accepted inputs: - `tbl_lazy` / `tbl_sql`: rendered via `dbplyr::sql_render()`. - `dbMatrix` / `dbSpatial` (S4 `[]` extractor returning   `tbl`): underlying lazy tbl extracted via `x[]`. - `data.frame`: forwarded [sqlrooms_export_table()] (materializes).

title: Register a lazy tbl or dbMatrix/dbSpatial as a VIEW in the SQL Rooms database — sqlrooms_register
code: if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{ library(dplyr) tbl(con, "cells") |>   filter(x > 0) |>   sqlrooms_register("cells_pos", x = _) } # }
